set.body:
Outcome: rigorously determine whether reframe4s-motion outperforms AFNI 3dvolreg and nifreeze in both speed and accuracy, and accept that claim only when a frozen reproducible court demonstrates statistically and practically meaningful superiority. FSL MCFLIRT remains an additional required comparator. The published motion artifact remains independent of filesystems, NIfTI, and external tools.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-430-01: An unpublished benchmark project depends on reframe4s-motion and image4s-nifti; reframe4s-motion itself remains filesystem- and NIfTI-independent.
AC-430-02: AFNI 3dvolreg, nifreeze, and FSL MCFLIRT are required comparators. Pairwise FLIRT and RNiftyReg may be secondary comparators, but required comparator absence fails the court rather than producing a silent skip.
AC-430-03: Every executable, container, dependency, dataset, configuration, scenario, and random seed is pinned or checksummed with provenance and license recorded.
AC-430-04: Synthetic convention fixtures prove transform direction, handedness, center, world affine, and reference-frame conversion before any comparator result is admitted.
AC-430-05: Accuracy is evaluated twice: recovered transforms are applied through one common canonical resampler to isolate estimation, and each tool is also evaluated as a native end-to-end correction pipeline.
AC-430-06: Independent full-affine continuous phantoms, independently rendered real-anatomy truth injection, and native real runs cover null, low, moderate, hard, nuisance, capture-range, anisotropic, oblique, permuted, and reflected cases where supported.
AC-430-07: Co-primary accuracy endpoints are physical landmark displacement p95 and corrected-image NRMSE. Relative rotation, framewise-displacement error, boundary and temporal fidelity, edge preservation, ringing, and failure rate are mandatory guardrails. DVARS and tSNR remain diagnostic rather than truth.
AC-430-08: Co-primary speed endpoints are matched end-to-end elapsed time and estimation-stage elapsed time. The court separately reports I/O, estimation, application, reporting, process startup, interpolation count, threads, warm-up, repetitions, median, p95, allocation where observable, peak RSS, temporary bytes, checksums, and failures.
AC-430-09: Before candidate results are inspected, the protocol fixes practical superiority margins, non-inferiority guardrails, independent sampling units, sample size or precision target, multiplicity control, scenario strata, execution randomization, exclusion policy, and cluster-aware confidence-interval method.
AC-430-10: For 3dvolreg and nifreeze separately, accepted outperformance requires the confidence bound for improvement to exceed the positive pre-registered practical margin on every co-primary speed and accuracy endpoint. Statistical significance alone, parity, or a speed-accuracy tradeoff is insufficient.
AC-430-11: Aggregate wins cannot hide a material scenario loss; every required stratum must pass its pre-registered guardrails with failures retained in the denominator.
AC-430-12: Manual and scheduled automation fails closed for missing required evidence and archives raw per-frame or per-run results, summaries, logs, versions, environment, and a human audit exposing every win, tie, loss, and exclusion.
AC-430-13: mig-434 adjudicates the frozen results. If superiority in both speed and accuracy against both 3dvolreg and nifreeze is not demonstrated, the report states that precisely and no outperformance claim is permitted.
AC-430-14: mig-415 cannot authorize duplicate removal until absolute correctness gates pass and the superiority decision has an explicit accepted or unmet disposition; an unmet research target may motivate further work but cannot be rewritten as success.
set.title: EPIC: Demonstrate speed and accuracy superiority over 3dvolreg and nifreeze
